content: In Micah, from which small town would Israel's ruler come?
explanation: Jesus was born there. “But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel” (Micah 5:2, BSB)

content: In Micah, what does the LORD require: act justly, love mercy, and what?
explanation: God has shown what is good. “to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?” (Micah 6:8, BSB)

content: In Micah, where will God cast all our sins?
options: Into the depths of the sea
explanation: He has compassion on us. “You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.” (Micah 7:19, BSB)

content: In Micah's vision of peace, what will nations beat their swords into?
explanation: They will train for war no more. “Then they will beat their swords into plowshares” (Micah 4:3, BSB)

content: In Micah, how old are the origins of the ruler from Bethlehem?
explanation: He is eternal. “One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.” (Micah 5:2, BSB)

content: In Micah, what does God delight in?
explanation: He does not stay angry forever. “who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?” (Micah 7:18, BSB)

content: In Micah, the prophet asks, “Who is a God like You, who pardons…”
explanation: God forgives His people. “Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity” (Micah 7:18, BSB)

content: In Micah's vision, what will nations turn their spears into?
explanation: Nation will not fight nation. “and their spears into pruning hooks.” (Micah 4:3, BSB)

content: In Micah, what town was the prophet Micah from?
explanation: He is called the Moreshite. “This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite” (Micah 1:1, BSB)

content: In Micah, what other name is given to Bethlehem?
explanation: It was small among Judah's clans. “But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah” (Micah 5:2, BSB)
